item.title: The Sonoma County Fair — Wed Aug 12, 10:00 AM — Sonoma County Fairgrounds
item.description:
A celebration of community spirit, agriculture, entertainment, and wholesome fun.
The Sonoma County Fair is an annual event that captivates visitors with its vibrant atmosphere and diverse offerings. Held in scenic Sonoma County, California, this fair is a celebration of community spirit, agriculture, entertainment, and wholesome fun. From thrilling amusement rides and live music performances to engaging exhibits showcasing local produce, crafts, and artwork, the fair offers something for everyone. Attendees can indulge in mouthwatering fair food, participate in thrilling competitions, enjoy live animal exhibits, and explore the region’s rich agricultural heritage. With its charming blend of entertainment and education, the Sonoma County Fair is a must-visit destination that brings joy and excitement to people of all ages.
Source: GoLocal Cooperative

item.title: Broadway Under the Stars - Mamma Mia! — Thu Aug 13, 7:00 PM — Sonoma Field of Dreams
item.description:
The global smash hit is coming to Sonoma for the very first time! Set on a sun-drenched Greek island, *Mamma Mia!* follows a young bride-to-be on a quest to discover the identity of her father — bringing three very unexpected guests from her mother’s past back into their lives. Fueled by ABBA’s greatest hits (including “Dancing Queen,” “Mamma Mia,” “The Winner Takes It All,” and more), this joyful tale of family, friendship, love, and second chances has captured the hearts of millions worldwide. With its large cast, explosive dance numbers, nonstop humor, and irresistible score, *Mamma Mia!* promises to be one of the biggest and most unforgettable productions in Transcendence history.
*Mamma Mia!* is presented through special arrangement with Music Theatre International (MTI). All authorized performance materials are also supplied by MTI. www.mtishows.com
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat

item.title: Kevin Paris — Fri Aug 14, 6:00 PM — Soul Yoga and Wellness
item.description:
Singer-songwriter, hug dealer and pioneer yoga musician, Paris has toured the world playing 1,500\+ shows independently.
Based in LA after living in Brazil, South Africa and all over the US, his feel-good music has grown into an “off the beaten path” fusion of folk-reggae-acoustic-electronic influences.
In addition, Paris is the go-to singer-songwriter paving the way for artists in the vibrant Yoga & Live Music scene. He has played for over a thousand yoga classes alongside renowned teachers and fellow musicians at festivals, retreats and studios around the globe.
No matter the venue, Paris’ unmistakable, feel-good music uplifts, connects, and keeps the movement moving. More at kevinparismusic.com

item.title: Monica Da Silva — Fri Aug 14, 8:00 PM — The Saint
item.description:
Monica da Silva grew up living between The United States and Belém, Brazil, a city on the Amazon River. A love of travel and foreign language helped to forge her unique sound.
Paralleling her life, da Silva's music contains an eclectic mix of Brazilian and American influences. Her sound can be classified as International Fusion, as it is heavily influenced by Brazilian music, namely Bossa Nova, but also incorporates elements of Lounge, Electronica, Indie Pop, and Worldbeat. Da Silva brings her cultural diversity to her songs, smoothly flowing between English, Portuguese, and Spanish.
In 2010, da Silva released her album "Brasilissima" . The record featured songs in both of her native languages - English and Portuguese. The first single "Aí Então", “was chosen by Putumayo World Music to be included on their compilation “Brazilian Beat”. item.title: Wood St. Film Screening — Wed Aug 19, 6:30 PM — Autonomous Gallery
item.description:
A Vallejo screening of the Wood Street documentary.
WOOD STREET follows a year in the life of Oakland’s largest unhoused encampment as its residents face an imminent eviction that threatens to dismantle their community. As notices appear and police move in, residents organize — building barricades, filing lawsuits, and protesting at City Hall to fight for their right to stay. The film places viewers inside the encampment, capturing the urgency, resilience, and emotional toll of collective resistance.
Free, but donations are appreciated
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: 2025 Santa Rosa Marathon — Sun Aug 23, 7:00 AM — Old Courthouse Square
item.description:
Lace up your sneakers and grab your friends—it’s time to run through the heart of California’s iconic wine country! Join us for the 17th Annual Santa Rosa Marathon, Half Marathon, 10K & 5K on August 23rd & 24th, 2025. Race through scenic vineyard-lined paths and picturesque rolling hills, all while enjoying mostly flat courses in stunning Sonoma County. Wine A Little, Run A Lot After giving it your all on the 5K, 10K, Half Marathon, or Marathon route, cross the finish line and head straight to the post-race celebration at Old Courthouse Square. 5K and 10K runners will enjoy one complimentary beer, while half marathon and marathon runners receive two complimentary beers and a bottle of wine from DeLoach Vineyards. Can’t make the live event? Run anytime, anywhere with our virtual run! Don’t miss out on this unforgettable race through one of the most beautiful regions in California. Register now!

item.title: How to Start Beekeeping - A Free Workshop — Sun Aug 23, 3:00 PM — Petaluma Bounty Community Farm
item.description:
Interested in keeping honey bees? Whether you're simply curious or ready to start your own hive, this free program by the Master Gardeners of Sonoma County will provide practical introduction to the rewarding world of beekeeping.
No registration needed.
Tom Courry, a beekeeper with 45 years of experience and a longtime member of the Sonoma County Beekeepers Association, will share an informative introduction to backyard beekeeping.
Tom's presentation will cover the fundamentals of beekeeping, including:
• Essential beekeeping equipment • Choosing the ideal location for your hive • Basic colony management • What to expect as a beginning beekeeper
Following the presentation, enjoy a guided tour of the Unity Demonstration Garden to learn about some of the best plants to support honey bees and other pollinators. See less
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat
